excludedFiles.reason: Information sheet requires scientific correction: presents tongue rolling as a simple inherited yes/no characteristic and treats eye colour as a continuous measurement; also labels variation as discreet rather than discrete. Withheld to avoid teaching these misconceptions.

excludedFiles.title: DNA
excludedFiles.reason: Requires scientific correction: identifies the DNA base A as adenosine rather than adenine, says every human cell contains nuclear DNA, and gives an inaccurate account of chromosome packaging.

excludedFiles.title: 10 PERIODIC TABLE QUEST
excludedFiles.reason: Dated periodicity booklet with embedded key: identifies radon as the heaviest noble gas and uses oversimplified orbital/period rules; substantial orbital and ionisation content also extends beyond lower-school scope. Requires correction before inclusion.

excludedFiles.title: 10 DNA & PROTEIN STRUCTURE IN EVOLUTION WORD CLOZE
excludedFiles.reason: Requires scientific correction: states that each gene codes for the same amino acid in all organisms, confusing genes with codons. Also depends on Pearson Science 10 page 88.

excludedFiles.title: 10 DNA WORKSHEET
excludedFiles.reason: Incomplete activity: instructions require a fourth sheet containing a DNA strand, but the document has only three pages and no matching strand template.

excludedFiles.title: 10 DOG BREED CHARACTERISTICS
excludedFiles.reason: Needs revision: presents broad dog-breed aggression and temperament generalisations as fixed biological facts without evidence; unsuitable as a reliable artificial-selection resource in its current form.

excludedFiles.title: 10 EVOLUTION ANSWER KEY
excludedFiles.reason: Misleading answer-key filename and scientific errors: this is largely notes and uncompleted tasks; misidentifies a horse–zebra hybrid as a zeedonk and claims all ligers are infertile.

excludedFiles.title: 10 FACTORS AFFECTING REACTION RATES PRACTICAL
excludedFiles.reason: Practical requires correction and teacher revision: describes molarity M as moles rather than moles per litre, gives no standard magnesium strip dimensions for fair comparison, and omits a risk assessment for heating sulfuric acid.

excludedFiles.title: 10 GROUPS OF THE PERIODIC TABLE
excludedFiles.reason: Requires scientific correction: states neutral hydrogen has a single positive charge, mixes historical and modern group numbering, and overgeneralises transition-metal properties.

excludedFiles.title: 10 NATURAL SELECTION LESSON 1

excludedFiles.title: 10 PERIODIC TABLE

excludedFiles.title: 10 SIMPLE PERIODIC TABLE
excludedFiles.reason: Outdated image-only periodic table: incomplete later-element entries. Replace with a current complete reference table.

excludedFiles.title: Classifying volcanoes
excludedFiles.reason: Requires scientific correction: presents eruption styles as a fixed least-to-most explosive sequence ending in Pelean eruptions and combines Plinian with Vulcanian descriptions inaccurately.
